devdoc.details: This contract inherits from SocketSrc and SocketDst

ErrInSourceValidation().details: Error emitted when source slugs deduced from packet id and msg id don't match

InvalidCapacitorAddress().details: Error triggerred when invalid capacitor address is provided

InvalidProof().details: Error emitted when proof is invalid

InvalidTokenAddress().details: thrown when the given token address don't have any code

InvalidTransmitter().details: Error thrown when non-transmitter tries to seal/propose

LowGasLimit().details: Error emitted when less gas limit is provided for execution than expected

MessageAlreadyExecuted().details: Error emitted when a message has already been executed

NoPermit(bytes32).details: Error message thrown when an address does not have permission to execute a function with onlyRole modifier.

NotExecutor().details: Error emitted when the executor is not valid

PlugDisconnected().details: Error triggerred when siblingPlug is not found

UnequalArrayLengths().details: thrown when array lengths are not equal

params.capacitorFactory: The address of the new capacitorFactory.

params.executionManager: The address of the new executionManager.

params.hasher: The address of the new hasher.

params.minMsgGasLimit: gas limit needed to execute the inbound at remote
params.msgId: message id packed with remoteChainSlug and nonce
params.payload: the data which will be used by inbound at remote

params.capacitor: capacitor selected based on outbound switchboard
params.decapacitor: decapacitor selected based on inbound switchboard
params.plug: address of plug on current chain
params.siblingPlug: address of plug on sibling chain

RoleGranted(bytes32,address).details: Emitted when a role is granted to an address.

RoleRevoked(bytes32,address).details: Emitted when a role is revoked from an address.

params.transmitter: address of transmitter that sealed this packet(recovered from sig)

claimOwner().details: Allows the nominated owner to claim ownership of the contract. Throws an error if the caller is not the nominee. Sets the nominated owner as the new owner of the contract. Emits an `OwnerClaimed` event with the address of the new owner.

params.inboundSwitchboard_: the address of switchboard to use for verifying messages at inbound
params.outboundSwitchboard_: the address of switchboard to use for sending messages
params.siblingPlug_: address of plug present at siblingChainSlug_ to call at inbound

params.executionDetails_: all inputs needed from the executor for executing this particular message
params.messageDetails_: the details needed for message verification

params.minMsgGasLimit_: The gas limit of the message.
params.payloadSize_: The byte length of payload of the message.
params.plug_: The address of the plug through which the message is sent.
params.siblingChainSlug_: The slug of the destination chain for the message.

returns.totalFees: The minimum fees required for the specified message.

params.plugAddress_: address of plug present at current chain

grantBatchRole(bytes32[],uint32[],addres.details: Grants multiple roles to multiple addresses in batch.

params.grantees_: The addresses to be granted the roles.
params.roleNames_: The names of the roles to grant.
params.slugs_: The slugs for chain specific roles. For roles which are not chain-specific, we can use slug = 0

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants a role to a given address.

params.grantee_: The address to grant the role to. Emits a RoleGranted event. Can only be called by the owner of the contract.

grantRoleWithSlug(bytes32,uint32,address.details: Grants a role to an address based on the role name and chain slug.

params.chainSlug_: The chain slug associated with the role.
params.grantee_: The address to be granted the role.

hasRole(bytes32,address).details: Checks whether an address has a specific role.

returns._0: A boolean value indicating whether or not the address has the role.

hasRoleWithSlug(bytes32,uint32,address).details: Checks if an address has a role based on the role name and chain slug.

params.address_: The address to check for the role.
params.chainSlug_: The chain slug associated with the role.

returns._0: A boolean indicating whether the address has the specified role.

isPacketProposed(bytes32,uint256,address.details: Checks whether the specified packet has been proposed.

params.packetId_: The ID of the packet to check.
params.proposalCount_: The proposal ID of the packetId to check.
params.switchboard_: The address of switchboard for which this packet is proposed

returns._0: A boolean indicating whether the packet has been proposed or not.

nominateOwner(address).details: Allows the current owner to nominate a new owner for the contract. Throws an error if the caller is not the owner. Emits an `OwnerNominated` event with the address of the nominee.

nominee().details: Returns the current nominee for ownership of the contract.

params.executionParams_: a 32 bytes param to add details for execution, for eg: fees to be paid for execution
params.minMsgGasLimit_: the minimum gas-limit needed to execute the payload on remote
params.payload_: bytes to be delivered to the Plug on the siblingChainSlug_
params.transmissionParams_: a 32 bytes param to add extra details for transmission

owner().details: Returns the current owner of the contract.

params.switchboard_: The address of switchboard for which this packet is proposed

params.capacitorType_: The type of capacitor that the switchboard uses.
params.maxPacketLength_: The maximum length of a packet allowed by the switchboard.
params.siblingChainSlug_: The slug of the sibling chain that the switchboard is registered with.

params.amount_: The amount of tokens to be rescued.
params.rescueTo_: The address where rescued tokens need to be sent.
params.token_: The address of the token contract.

revokeBatchRole(bytes32[],uint32[],addre.details: Revokes multiple roles from multiple addresses in batch.

params.grantees_: The addresses to be revoked the roles.
params.roleNames_: The names of the roles to revoke.
params.slugs_: The slugs for chain specific roles. For roles which are not chain-specific, we can use slug = 0

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes a role from a given address.

params.revokee_: The address to revoke the role from. Emits a RoleRevoked event. Can only be called by the owner of the contract.

params.chainSlug_: The chain slug associated with the role.
params.grantee_: The addresses to be revoked the roles.
params.roleName_: The names of the roles to revoke.

params.batchSize_: size of batch to be sealed

setCapacitorFactory(address).details: Set the capacitor factory contractOnly governance can call this function

params.capacitorFactory_: The address of the capacitor factory contract

setExecutionManager(address).details: Only governance can call this function

setHasher(address).details: Only governance can call this function

setTransmitManager(address).details: Only governance can call this functionThis function sets the transmitManager address. If it is ever upgraded, remove the fees from executionManager first, and then upgrade address at socket.

useSiblingSwitchboard(uint32,address).details: This function is expected to be only called by switchboard.the event emitted is tracked by transmitters to decide which switchboard a packet should be proposed on

params.siblingChainSlug_: The slug of the sibling chain

devdoc.title: Socket

CapacitorFactorySet(address).notice: An event that is emitted when the capacitor factory is updated.

ExecutionManagerSet(address).notice: An event that is emitted when the executionManager is updated.

ExecutionSuccess(bytes32).notice: emits the status of message after inbound call

HasherSet(address).notice: An event that is emitted when the hasher is updated.

MessageOutbound(uint32,address,uint32,ad.notice: emits the message details when a new message arrives at outbound

PacketProposed(address,bytes32,uint256,b.notice: emits the packet details when proposed at remote

PlugConnected(address,uint32,address,add.notice: emits the config set by a plug for a remoteChainSlug

Sealed(address,bytes32,uint256,bytes32,b.notice: Emits as soon as a capacitor is sealed

TransmitManagerSet(address).notice: An event that is emitted when a new transmitManager contract is set

connect(uint32,address,address,address).notice: connects Plug to Socket and sets the config for given `siblingChainSlug_`msg.sender is stored as plug address against given configuration

execute((bytes32,uint256,uint256,bytes,b.notice: Executes a message that has been delivered by transmitters and authenticated by switchboards

getMinFees(uint256,uint256,bytes32,bytes.notice: Retrieves the minimum fees required for a message with a specified gas limit and destination chain.

getPlugConfig(address,uint32).notice: returns the config for given `plugAddress_` and `siblingChainSlug_`

outbound(uint32,uint256,bytes32,bytes32,.notice: To send message to a connected remote chain. Should only be called by a plug.

proposeForSwitchboard(bytes32,bytes32,ad.notice: the signature is validated if it belongs to transmitter or not

registerSwitchboardForSibling(uint32,uin.notice: deploy capacitor and decapacitor for a switchboard with a specified max packet length, sibling chain slug, and capacitor type.

rescueFunds(address,address,uint256).notice: Rescues funds from the contract if they are locked by mistake. This contract does not theoretically need this function but it is added for safety.

seal(uint256,address,bytes).notice: seals data in capacitor for specific batchSize

useSiblingSwitchboard(uint32,address).notice: Emits the sibling switchboard for given `siblingChainSlug_`.

userdoc.notice: Core-contract containing all the core-socket utilities.
